milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining (breaking) an acacia door causes it to drop as an acacia_door item that automatically enters the player's inventory. The player starts with an empty inventory, so having at least 1 acacia_door confirms the door was successfully mined. This is preferred over spatial rules (like count_in_box_at_most for the door block disappearing) because inventory_has is the first-choice rule for mine tasks per the preference order.
